name: rfp-builder
description: Prepare a buyer-side software RFP by discovering business workflows, operating teams, admin controls, AI boundaries and launch acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Discover your business and prepare a software RFP
interface.longDescription: Guided discovery for buyers, founders, operations teams, fractional CTOs and consultants preparing software RFPs. Explore workflows, scale, operator capacity, admin actions, human review, integrations, data boundaries and launch acceptance. Produce a vendor-neutral editable brief and render a PDF in an execution-capable environment. No automatic lead capture or vendor submission.
defaultPrompt: Interview me to create an RFP for a software application my business will operate.
Review my draft RFP for missing workflows, admin controls and human review capacity.
Help me brief vendors as a fractional CTO, with testable acceptance and comparable pricing.
